verdict.rationale: CockroachDB ships official CLIs — the `cockroach` binary (with `demo`, `start-single-node`, install via Homebrew) and the `ccloud` CLI for managing Cloud clusters — well documented in first-party docs, giving AI-native/agentic users scriptable command-line access to spin up clusters and run SQL. Missing for 10: no CLI-specific AI-native features (e.g., agent-oriented subcommands) or independent hands-on corroboration of AI-agent CLI usage specifically.
